name: Grilled honeycomb cake
summary: A sweet honeycomb cake grilled until the sugar scorches a little, so each bite is slightly burnt and bitter as well as sweet.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 names bánh bò nướng as an afternoon snack at the central market.
howToEat: Buy it warm at the central market in the afternoon.
where: Buon Ma Thuot central market, in the afternoon.
seoTitle: Banh bo nuong in Buon Ma Thuot — grilled at the market
seoDescription: Sweet honeycomb cake grilled until the sugar turns slightly bitter, at the central market in the afternoon.
